OrderBookIdentification.name: Order Book Identification
OrderBookIdentification.definition: Alphanumerical code established by the trading venue for each and every order book.

SequenceNumber.name: Sequence Number
SequenceNumber.definition: Unique number assigned in ascending order to each event.

TimeStamp.name: Time Stamp
TimeStamp.definition: Date and time of each event/auction.

TradeVenue.name: Trade Venue
TradeVenue.definition: Identification of the venue where the transaction was executed.

FinancialInstrument.name: Financial Instrument
FinancialInstrument.definition: Identification of the financial instrument(s) to which the order refers to.

OrderIdentification.name: Order Identification
OrderIdentification.definition: Alphanumerical code assigned by the operator of the trading venue to the individual order.

DateOfReceipt.name: Date Of Receipt
DateOfReceipt.definition: Date of receipt of the original order.

ValidityPeriod.name: Validity Period
ValidityPeriod.definition: Defines the conditions under which an order becomes active or is removed from an orderbook.

OrderRestriction.name: Order Restriction
OrderRestriction.definition: Indicates information about order restriction, such as the trading phase when the order becomes active.

ValidityDateTime.name: Validity Date Time
ValidityDateTime.definition: Timestamp reflecting the time on which the order becomes active or it is ultimately removed from the order book.

EventType.name: Event Type
EventType.definition: Events affecting the orders in financial instruments.
